issues.description: The problem statement's UML and method listing indicate acceptSupplyDelivery should be a public ("+") method on SealSaloon, but the solution implements it with package-private visibility (no access modifier). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended API and may cause access problems if callers (e.g., tests or external code) expect a public static method.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the acceptSupplyDelivery method in SealSaloon to be public static (i.e., public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(...)) so its visibility matches the UML/specification and is unambiguous for students and external callers.
